<a name="Context"></a>
## type Context

Context holds platform runtime configuration \(secret names, cluster identity, webhook URLs\) sourced from the process environment.

```go
type Context struct {
    Environment string
    ClusterName string

    // ---- Secrets (names) ----
    GitSSHSecretName         string
    ContainerRegistrySecret  string
    CrossplaneProviderSecret string
    WebhookURLSecret         string

    // ---- Explicit URLs ----
    GitHubWebhookURL string

    Extra map[string]string
}
```

<a name="FromEnv"></a>
### func FromEnv

```go
func FromEnv() *Context
```

FromEnv builds a Context from BLANKETOPS\_\* environment variables, falling back to platform defaults for anything unset.
